# sigma_connection_path (Data Source)

Looks up a single Sigma connection path using POST `/v2/connection/{connectionId}/lookup`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_connection_path" "example" {
  connection_id = "connection-id"
  path          = ["DATABASE", "SCHEMA", "TABLE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) Connection ID.
- `path` (List of String) Non-empty fully qualified path components.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Returned inode ID.
- `inode_id` (String) Connection path inode ID.
- `kind` (String) Object kind returned by lookup.
- `url` (String) Connection URL returned by lookup.
